grandparents_cupboard.reason: Potatoes, tinned tomatoes, tinned haricot beans, spinach and olive oil are all plain home staples, with nothing factory-made.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at any mainstream UK supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a frying pan with a lid and a small pan, using simple frying and simmering.

works.reason: 600g potatoes with two tins of beans and a tin of tomatoes is a filling breakfast for four, and the covered-then-uncovered frying will cook 1cm cubes through and crisp them.

honest_times.reason: Dicing 600g potatoes and slicing spring onions and garlic fits in 12 minutes, and the 18 to 20 minutes of potato frying matches the 20 cook minutes, with the beans done alongside.

honest_ingredients.reason: All listed items are used, the names match their ids, and the step's '2 tsp paprika' clearly refers to the listed smoked paprika.

seasonal_feel.reason: Stored potatoes are the bulk of a warm April breakfast hash, with garden spinach, spring onions and chives in season.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are plain, clear British English with no restaurant language or preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: Potatoes, beans, tomatoes and spinach make a proper, filling breakfast of real food that a family would happily eat again.
